text.nea.enable.animationsmoothing.toolt.en: Smooths out the arm/leg animations to make them look more natural and less jumpy

text.nea.smoothingSpeed.tooltip.en: The amount of smoothing to apply to the arm/leg animations

text.nea.enable.inworldmaprendering.tool.en: Renders the map in the world instead of just in first person

text.nea.enable.offhandhiding.tooltip.en: Hide offhand items when pulling a bow

text.nea.enable.rotationlocking.tooltip.en: Locks the rotation of the player's body to the rotation of the player's head

text.nea.enable.ladderanimation.tooltip.en: Adds an animation for climbing ladders(note: only ladders, not vines, scaffolding, etc.)

text.nea.enable.eatdringanimation.toolti.en: Adds an animation for eating and drinking

text.nea.enable.rowboatanimation.tooltip.en: Adds an animation for rowing a boat

text.nea.enable.horseanimation.tooltip.en: Adds an animation for riding a horse

text.nea.enable.dontholditemsinbed.toolt.en: Prevents the player from holding items while in bed

text.nea.enable.freezearmsinbed.tooltip.en: Prevents the player from moving their arms while in bed

text.nea.rotationlock.tooltip.en: The type of rotation locking to use

text.nea.enable.showlastusedsword.toolti.en: [Deprecated for removal! Use other mods for this feature!] Shows the last used sword on the player. This is just a visual effect without knowledge of the actual inventory. Please don't report 'bugs' that the sword is still rendered after throwing it away/putting it in a chest/etc.

text.nea.enable.crawling.tooltip.en: Adds an animation for crawling, replacing the vanilla 'crawling'(swimming) animation

text.nea.enable.rotatetoladder.tooltip.en: Rotates the player's body to face the ladder when climbing it

text.nea.holdUpItemsMode.tooltip.en: Makes the player to hold up items(like they are looking at them/holding them in front of them)

text.nea.holdUpItemOffset.tooltip.en: Modify how much the item is held up

text.nea.ladderAnimationAmplifier.toolti.en: The amount of movement to apply to the arms when climbing a ladder

text.nea.ladderAnimationArmHeight.toolti.en: The height of the arms when climbing a ladder

text.nea.ladderAnimationArmSpeed.tooltip.en: The speed of the arms when climbing a ladder

text.nea.enable.itemSwapAnimation.toolti.en: Adds an animation for swapping items from the main hand to the off hand and vice versa

text.nea.enable.tweakElytraAnimation.too.en: Tweaks the elytra flying animation to make it look more natural

text.nea.enable.petAnimation.tooltip.en: Adds an animation for petting wolfs and cats. Look at the wolf/cat while sneaking to pet it

text.nea.enable.huggingAnimation.tooltip.en: Adds an animation for hugging. Look at another player while sneaking to 'hug' them

text.nea.enable.narutoRunning.tooltip.en: Adds an animation for running in the style of Naruto(easter egg)

text.nea.enable.enableInWorldBookRenderi.en: Renders books in the world with their text. This is still a work in progress and may not work properly

text.nea.disableLegSmoothing.tooltip.en: Disables the smoothing of the legs

text.nea.enable.bowAnimation.tooltip.en: The type of bow animation to use
